fusions.name: Branch Line
fusions.desc: Sends a spark down the line into the first enemy in its path; it deals 7 damage, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Both Lanes
fusions.desc: Sends 2 runaway carts down diverging lanes at once; each deals 11 damage and stuns what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Change of Route
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and moves you 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Two Tracks Ahead
fusions.desc: Each time you have travelled far enough, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
